$Comment: What a player sees and hears when a quest's last objective is met but the reward WAITS to be
collected instead of paying out on the spot: a quest authored to be collected somewhere, a
player with no room for the reward, or one who finished away from the place it is collected.
This is the library's own neutral default. A mod that ships a file with this same name in its
own pack replaces it, and a server owner can do the same from the owner layer.
The moment carries 'quest' (its id), 'title' (its name in the reader's language), 'parked'
(true here), 'reason' (why it waits: collect for a quest meant to be collected, no_space when
the reward would not fit, away when they finished somewhere other than where it is collected)
and, for a quest collected somewhere in particular, 'turnIn' (character or accept_site).
'player' is always the name of who finished it.
Variants is how ONE file says different things for different cases: each entry names, under
When, the values it applies to and restates only the groups that differ. The first entry that
